item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Decision actions in Azure Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Decision actions are in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. They let developers automate business decisions with AI without deploying or managing models.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Enhanced developer experience in Azure Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps Automation is in public preview with updated developer experiences for building, managing, and scaling business process automation. The preview includes a refreshed workflow designer and reusable templates, along with faster environment and application setup.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Managed AI Models in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Managed AI Models are in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. They let developers add AI capabilities to workflows and agents without provisioning, deploying, or managing model infrastructure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: New built-in Azure automation connectors in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps Automation now has new built-in Azure automation connectors in public preview. The connectors support workflow automation across GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Azure management services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: New integration, hybrid deployment, and observability capabilities in Azure Logic Apps
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps added preview capabilities for enterprise integration, hybrid deployment, and observability. The update is aimed at running workflows across cloud and on-premises environments and modernizing legacy integrations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Virtual network integration in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Virtual network (VNet) integration is now in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. This lets workflows and agents connect securely to resources inside Azure virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates
